art Pangram 4, on 19 external benchmarks and three datasets that we create ourselves: IDEASHIFT,

with shared provenance (fully human or fully AI) as well as documents with mixed provenance
(human ideas and AI prose, or AI ideas and human prose). Idea detectors should achieve high
accuracy in all four quadrants, while prose detectors should fail in the two mixed quadrants.
